notice: Fictional planning exercise only. Capability states, costs, effects and resource eligibility are simulated; no site, damage, stock or deployment condition is verified.

communityPoints.dateCaveat: generatedAt is the conversion timestamp, not the date each location was surveyed.

method.score: Sum of dimension weight multiplied by simulated level (0, 0.5 or 1). Historical cyclone proximity is not an input.
method.assumptionAssignment: Stable SHA-256 assignment from modelVersion, communityId and dimension; not inferred from a community's actual conditions. A route/power consistency constraint is then applied.
method.resourceEffect: Eligible resources advance one state in exactly one target dimension; scoreAfter is recalculated using the same weights.
method.missingActualData: Unknown real-world capability is not zero. These complete fictional scenarios must never be presented as verified assessments.
method.costUnits: Relative simulation units, not dollars or procurement estimates.

states.meaning: Assume only one usable communications route.
Assume a backup route exists but independence or testing is unconfirmed.
Assume an independent backup route was tested in the exercise.
Assume no usable backup power at the planning point.
Assume backup power exists but duration or testing is unconfirmed.
Assume backup power meets the scenario target and was tested.
Assume no communications continuity plan for a hypothetical critical service.
Assume a plan exists but coverage or testing is incomplete.
Assume the hypothetical service has a tested continuity plan.
Assume alerts depend on one online channel.
Assume an offline or alternate channel exists but was not tested.
Assume alternate alerts and offline information were tested.
Assume no named owner or exercise schedule.
Assume an owner is named but a drill or maintenance review is pending.
Assume an owner, drill and maintenance review are in place.

resourceCatalog.effect: Advance target dimension by one simulated state, capped at level 1

resourceCatalog.caveat: Equipment compatibility, duration target, fuel and maintenance still require verification.

resourceCatalog.caveat: No real facility-to-community relationship or installation location is asserted.
resourceCatalog.effect: Advance target dimension by one simulated state, capped at level 1

resourceCatalog.caveat: Language, distribution and actual community reach require local design and testing.
